results.question: 查一下最近 7 天西湖区每天的清运总量
results.sql: SELECT rm.route_date AS 日期, SUM(rm.total_weight) AS 清运量_kg FROM t_route_manifest rm JOIN t_region r ON rm.region_id = r.id WHERE r.region_name = '西湖区' AND rm.route_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY rm.route_date ORDER BY rm.route_date LIMIT 1000
results.detail: 值一致但列顺序/别名不同（2 行）

results.question: 本月各区域的清运量排名
results.sql: SELECT r.region_name AS 区域, SUM(rm.total_weight) AS 总清运量_kg FROM t_route_manifest rm JOIN t_region r ON rm.region_id = r.id WHERE rm.route_date >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY r.region_name ORDER BY 总清运量_kg DESC LIMIT 1000

results.question: 上个月每个区每天的平均清运量是多少
results.sql: SELECT r.region_name AS 区域, rm.route_date AS 日期, AVG(rm.total_weight) AS 日均清运量_kg FROM t_route_manifest rm JOIN t_region r ON rm.region_id = r.id WHERE rm.route_date >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1 month' AND rm.route_date < date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY r.region_name, rm.route_date ORDER BY r.region_name, rm.route_date LIMIT 1000

results.question: 西湖区今年一共清运了多少公斤垃圾
results.sql: SELECT r.region_name AS 区域, SUM(rm.total_weight) AS 总清运量_kg FROM t_route_manifest rm JOIN t_region r ON rm.region_id = r.id WHERE r.region_name = '西湖区' AND rm.route_date >= date_trunc('year', CURRENT_DATE) AND rm.route_date < date_trunc('year', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '1 year' GROUP BY r.region_name LIMIT 1000
results.detail: 期望列全部正确，额外多给 1 列

results.question: 统计上个月所有车辆的出车趟次和总清运量，排个名
results.sql: SELECT v.plate_number AS 车牌号, SUM(rm.total_trips) AS 出车趟次, SUM(rm.total_weight) AS 总清运量_kg FROM t_route_manifest rm JOIN t_vehicle v ON rm.vehicle_id = v.id WHERE rm.route_date >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1 month' AND rm.route_date < date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY v.plate_number ORDER BY 总清运量_kg DESC LIMIT 1000

results.question: 这个月清运量最高的前 10 辆车
results.sql: SELECT v.plate_number AS 车牌号, SUM(rm.total_weight) AS 总清运量_kg FROM t_route_manifest rm JOIN t_vehicle v ON rm.vehicle_id = v.id WHERE rm.route_date >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY v.plate_number ORDER BY 总清运量_kg DESC LIMIT 10

results.question: 所有车历史累计出车趟次，从高到低
results.sql: SELECT v.plate_number AS 车牌号, SUM(rm.total_trips) AS 累计出车趟次 FROM t_route_manifest rm JOIN t_vehicle v ON rm.vehicle_id = v.id GROUP BY v.plate_number ORDER BY 累计出车趟次 DESC LIMIT 1000

results.question: 每个区域清运量最大的那辆车分别是谁
results.sql: WITH vehicle_totals AS (SELECT rm.region_id, rm.vehicle_id, SUM(rm.total_weight) AS total_weight FROM t_route_manifest rm GROUP BY rm.region_id, rm.vehicle_id), ranked AS (SELECT region_id, vehicle_id, total_weight, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region_id ORDER BY total_weight DESC) AS rn FROM vehicle_totals) SELECT r.region_name AS 区域, v.plate_number AS 车牌号, ranked.total_weight AS 清运量_kg FROM ranked JOIN t_region r ON ranked.region_id = r.id JOIN t_vehicle v ON ranked.vehicle_id = v.id WHERE ranked.rn = 1 ORDER BY r.region_name LIMIT 1000
results.detail: 值一致但列顺序/别名不同（5 行）

results.question: 最近一周所有预警事件明细，按时间倒序

results.question: 各区域每个月的清运量，按月汇总
results.sql: SELECT r.region_name AS 区域, date_trunc('month', rm.route_date) AS 月份, SUM(rm.total_weight) AS 清运量_kg FROM t_route_manifest rm JOIN t_region r ON rm.region_id = r.id GROUP BY r.region_name, date_trunc('month', rm.route_date) ORDER BY 区域, 月份 LIMIT 1000

results.question: 每辆车平均每天的清运量

results.question: 这个月既有超速预警、清运量又排前 5 的车
results.sql: WITH top5 AS (SELECT v.id, v.plate_number, SUM(rm.total_weight) AS total_weight FROM t_route_manifest rm JOIN t_vehicle v ON rm.vehicle_id = v.id WHERE rm.route_date >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY v.id, v.plate_number ORDER BY total_weight DESC LIMIT 5), overspeed AS (SELECT DISTINCT vehicle_id FROM t_alert WHERE alert_type = '超速' AND alert_time >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)) SELECT t.plate_number AS 车牌号, t.total_weight AS 本月清运量_kg FROM top5 t JOIN overspeed o ON t.id = o.vehicle_id ORDER BY t.total_weight DESC LIMIT 1000
